cwe_content.cwe: CWE-668,Exposure of Resource to Wrong Sphere

candidate.Reason: The code binds a ZMQ socket to a fixed path in /tmp which can be accessed by any user on the system, potentially allowing unprivileged users to interfere with Keylime operations.
The code connects to a ZMQ socket using a fixed path in /tmp which can be accessed by any user on the system, potentially allowing unprivileged users to interfere with Keylime operations.
The code checks for and removes a fixed path in /tmp which can be accessed by any user on the system, potentially allowing unprivileged users to interfere with Keylime operations.
